The Subtask Name: Retrieval specialist skilled at web search, browsing and summarizing evidence
Agents_edges:
- From_agent: Orchestrator
  To_agent: WebServing_Expert
  agent_dependency_type: decision_dependency
  agent_strength: 0.85
  agent_explanation: The Orchestrator repeatedly invokes and directs the WebServing_Expert to act (e.g., steps 1, 3, 5, 7, 9), steering the search strategy and when to switch or persist.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: loop_issue
      description: Repeated re-invocation without strategic change leads to a loop.
      severity: 0.70
      if_from_agent_wrong: The Orchestrator keeps calling the same agent with the same goal despite stalled progress.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The WebServing_Expert continues repeating similar actions and messages, stalling the subtask.
    - type: data_issue
      description: Misframing the retrieval target or providing ambiguous directives.
      severity: 0.40
      if_from_agent_wrong: The WebServing_Expert may search for the wrong resource or miss key evidence.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: Produces irrelevant search attempts and inaccurate or unhelpful outputs.
    - type: irrecoverability_issue
      description: Persisting with an unworkable access method without adaptation.
      severity: 0.60
      if_from_agent_wrong: The Orchestrator’s insistence on the same approach prevents pivoting to viable methods.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The agent remains constrained and cannot progress to gather needed evidence.
- From_agent: WebServing_Expert
  To_agent: Orchestrator
  agent_dependency_type: environment_feedback
  agent_strength: 0.80
  agent_explanation: The WebServing_Expert reports search outcomes and constraints back to the Orchestrator (e.g., step 4 “Based on the search results…”, step 6 scraping failure, steps 10 and 12–31 “cannot directly access the webpage”).
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: loop_issue
      description: Reiterating the same access limitation without proposing alternatives.
      severity: 0.80
      if_from_agent_wrong: The agent keeps giving identical guidance (“manually check the link”), offering no new path.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: Orchestrator receives no new signal to adapt, reinforcing the loop.
    - type: data_issue
      description: Misidentifying sources or misreporting results.
      severity: 0.50
      if_from_agent_wrong: Incorrect links or summaries are passed as feedback.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: Orchestrator may commit to a wrong line of inquiry or miss relevant materials.
    - type: irrecoverability_issue
      description: Failure to articulate alternative retrieval plans.
      severity: 0.50
      if_from_agent_wrong: Orchestrator lacks actionable next steps.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: Subtask stalls due to absence of constructive feedback.
- From_agent: WebServing_Expert
  To_agent: WebServing_Expert
  agent_dependency_type: loop_control
  agent_strength: 0.90
  agent_explanation: The agent repeatedly emits the same “cannot access webpage; manually check” message across many turns (steps 12–31), self-reinforcing the loop without strategy change.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: loop_issue
      description: Self-repetition without introducing new techniques (e.g., alternative sources).
      severity: 0.90
      if_from_agent_wrong: The agent continues cycling through the same unproductive response.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: No progress within the subtask; opportunity cost increases.
    - type: irrecoverability_issue
      description: No pivot to different tools or data sources within agent capabilities.
      severity: 0.60
      if_from_agent_wrong: The agent exhausts the turn budget without actionable output.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The subtask may become irrecoverable without external intervention.

The Subtask Name: Python coder who can read local files (csv, xlsx, pdf, image, audio) and verify answers with code
Agents_edges:
- From_agent: Orchestrator
  To_agent: Verification_Expert
  agent_dependency_type: decision_dependency
  agent_strength: 0.80
  agent_explanation: The Orchestrator delegates to the Python coder to change approach after retrieval stalls (step 32).
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: data_issue
      description: Poorly specified query or task for coding-based verification.
      severity: 0.40
      if_from_agent_wrong: The coder searches or codes against the wrong targets.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: Wasted effort and potential misverification.
    - type: loop_issue
      description: Switching agents without changing method meaningfully.
      severity: 0.30
      if_from_agent_wrong: The coder might replicate prior web searches instead of using coding tools.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: Minimal progress; risk of falling back into similar loops.
- From_agent: Verification_Expert
  To_agent: Orchestrator
  agent_dependency_type: environment_feedback
  agent_strength: 0.65
  agent_explanation: The coder reports a new plan and initiates a search for detailed descriptions (step 33), signaling a shift from stalled retrieval to targeted verification attempts.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: data_issue
      description: Using generic search instead of leveraging coding/data-processing strengths.
      severity: 0.50
      if_from_agent_wrong: The coder’s feedback remains high-level and overlaps with earlier retrieval steps.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: Orchestrator receives limited new value and may fail to adapt strategy.
    - type: irrecoverability_issue
      description: Not proposing code-based verification or alternative data ingestion.
      severity: 0.30
      if_from_agent_wrong: The subtask misses its unique capability to validate from files or structured data.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: Reduced chance to conclusively verify the answer.

The Subtask Name: Checker that re-runs verification and enforces grounding in cited evidence
Agents_edges:
- From_agent: Orchestrator
  To_agent: VerificationExpert
  agent_dependency_type: memory_ref
  agent_strength: 0.60
  agent_explanation: The Orchestrator initially configures this checker role (step 0), establishing its availability and purpose for grounding and re-verification.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: irrecoverability_issue
      description: Misnaming or misconfiguring the checker (VerificationExpert vs. Verification_Expert) causes role confusion.
      severity: 0.60
      if_from_agent_wrong: The intended checker may not be invoked or may be conflated with the coder.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The checker cannot perform grounding, risking unverified conclusions.
- From_agent: Orchestrator
  To_agent: VerificationExpert
  agent_dependency_type: decision_dependency
  agent_strength: 0.55
  agent_explanation: The Orchestrator signals intent to start a new conversation with experts to resolve the task (step 37), implying eventual engagement of the checker to enforce evidence grounding.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: loop_issue
      description: Intent to involve the checker without actually invoking them.
      severity: 0.40
      if_from_agent_wrong: The checker remains idle while loops persist among other agents.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: No grounding occurs; the subtask’s value is unrealized.
